## About
Xpress Tire and Auto Repair is a local, family owned and operated tire and auto shop in Saint Paul. Before this shop, we owned Affordable Tire right here in town, and we've moved into a new, larger facility with the tools and machines for the job.
Whether you're a lifelong local, new in town or just passing through, we want to treat you like a friend, with fair rates and true care for your car. Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 243 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tire Sales: Quality tires from brands we know and trust, at affordable rates. Our inventory changes, so stop in and see what we have.
- Used tires: Good used tires, mounted and balanced. One reviewer put it simply: why buy new when slightly used will do.
- Tire repair: One customer had a tire repaired in about 10 minutes and was back on the road.
- Auto Repairs: Tune ups, brakes, engine repair, oil changes and more, with a fair price and quick, often same day, turnaround.
- Shocks and struts replacement: Worn shocks and struts replaced so your car rides and handles the way it should.
- Hose and belt replacement: We replace worn hoses and belts before they leave you stuck.
- Car Audio Installation: We install car audio, too.
- General auto maintenance: The regular upkeep that keeps your car getting you from point A to point B and beyond.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Sunday.

Q: Can my car be done the same day?
A: Often, yes. We aim for quick, often same day, turnaround on auto repairs. Give us a call and we'll let you know.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. One reviewer had good used tires mounted and balanced and was in and out fast.
